description: Ask one website's chatbot a question and get the answer a real visitor would receive. Use this to test the bot. It spends one message from the account's monthly allowance, and it calls an external model provider.

message.description: The question to ask, as a visitor would type it.

session_id.description: Reuse the same value across calls to continue one test conversation. Omit to start a fresh one.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: ask_ai
title: Ask the chatbot a question
